name: US–China / Taiwan
value: Trade truce to 10 Jan; Shenzhen APEC next week
summary: US and China extended their trade truce to 10 Jan 2027 on 9 Nov; Trump and Xi expected at APEC in Shenzhen next week
state: China and the US extended their trade truce to 10 Jan 2027 on 9 Nov, and Presidents Trump and Xi are expected to meet at APEC in Shenzhen in the week of 16 Nov (The National). Taiwan's defence ministry reported heightened PLA activity around the island in early November, after analysts flagged a possible unannounced exercise; this is not confirmed (Taipei Times, 4 Nov). No blockade, clash or severed channel was reported as of 10 Nov.
for_you: Dialogue is active, but military pressure around Taiwan keeps a risk to shipping and chip supply chains. Travellers should check FCDO travel advice for Taiwan and China.
rubric_hit: Elevated PLA activity around Taiwan; no blockade, quarantine or clash

sources.title: The National — China extends pause on rare earth export curbs for two months
Taipei Times — Heightened Chinese activity detected

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
